technical-summary: Flash-Next bump parity harness: flashnext-parity.sh measure launches production flashnext-4gpu (policy on via the calibration record, derived warmup), measures cold 27k-token TTFT, 44k doc prefill, decode ms/step at 1 and 6 streams, 8-session TTFT/ms-step, and ~256k-token prefill and ms/step, N launches -> parity.json; baseline derives per-metric tolerances from launch-to-launch and within-launch spread (refuses one launch); compare gates one-sided regressions, never acceptance. bump-radiance step 4 uses it before and after every bump.
user-summary-candidate: A checked-in Flash-Next parity harness locks in performance before a Radiance bump and checks the bump against it.
